caption: Cheerful children's sing-along song for preschool TV in the style of modern nursery-rhyme channels, warm friendly lead vocals with a happy group of cartoon animal voices joining on the chorus, call and response, bright ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass, light drums, farmyard sound effects, playful animal sound effects, catchy repeating chorus, happy, silly, major key, polished modern kids music production, clear diction, easy for toddlers to sing along
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Let's make some noise! Let's go!

[Chorus]
What do the animals say, say, say?
Let's all make the sounds today!
Loud sounds, soft sounds, one, two, three,
Make the animal sounds with me!

[Verse]
Rory the lion goes roar, roar, roar,
A great big roar from the jungle floor!
Roar like Rory, loud as can be,
Roar, roar, roar with me!

[Chorus]
What do the animals say, say, say?
Let's all make the sounds today!
Loud sounds, soft sounds, one, two, three,
Make the animal sounds with me!

[Verse]
Ziggy the kitten goes meow, meow, meow,
Soft and gentle, show me how!
Meow like Ziggy, quiet as can be,
Meow, meow, meow with me!

[Chorus]
What do the animals say, say, say?
Let's all make the sounds today!
Loud sounds, soft sounds, one, two, three,
Make the animal sounds with me!

[Verse]
Waffles the puppy goes woof, woof, woof,
Woof so loud it shakes the roof!
Woof like Waffles, happy as can be,
Woof, woof, woof with me!

[Chorus]
What do the animals say, say, say?
Let's all make the sounds today!
Loud sounds, soft sounds, one, two, three,
Make the animal sounds with me!

[Verse]
Pebble the penguin goes squawk, squawk, squawk,
Squawking as he likes to walk!
Squawk like Pebble, silly as can be,
Squawk, squawk, squawk with me!

[Bridge]
Roar! Meow! Woof! Squawk!
Now let's do them all and walk!
Roar! Meow! Woof! Squawk!
The Paws and Claws Club loves to talk!

[Chorus]
What do the animals say, say, say?
Let's all make the sounds today!
Loud sounds, soft sounds, one, two, three,
Make the animal sounds with me!

[Chorus]
What do the animals say, say, say?
Let's all make the sounds today!
Loud sounds, soft sounds, one, two, three,
Make the animal sounds with me!

[Outro]
What a noisy club! Bye bye, friends!
